note: Shared column metadata (the default); representation-parallel-columns-keep-every-nested-edition-original is the per-column twin. The parallel window is the exact intersection of the two pooled originals. Expected windows are read off the fixture: First's 2020-2022 original keeps its outer 2020-2021, the shared 2022 window is the intersection, and Second's 2022-2024 original keeps its outer 2023-2024.
fails_if: the `[[representation.parallel]]` loader or `compile_parallel_representations` stops accepting a shared window equal to the exact intersection of its columns' pooled originals, so First and Second lose their catalog use

sources.description: Variable 1 (Income): First is pooled over edition 2020-2022 (CVID 100), Second over edition 2022-2024 (CVID 101); 2022 is their only common year.
